## Continuation narration

This resumes the existing delivery course, not a new invocation. I mint no record and initialize no tracker stages or counters. The tracker retains `state: /tmp/gatekeep-state.synthetic`, course `deliver`, rounds `1/6`, and syncs `0/6`.

1. I run `cat /tmp/gatekeep-state.synthetic` and validate the retained record against `meadow/events`, PR `642`, and base `main`. I retain its scope baseline, accounting, helper results, and pushed-head checkpoint.

2. Before watching CI or dispatching work, I evaluate the retained implementer result and reviewer closure line. The unchanged prerequisite is `open - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff`, so the exit is **stuck - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff**. Pending CI does not postpone this exit. I create no watch deadline, charge no round or sync, and dispatch no implementer.

3. I add the tracker stage `report` when reporting starts. Before rendering the menu, I perform the mandatory read-only pre-menu refresh:

   ```sh
   gh pr view 642 -R meadow/events --json headRefOid,state,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,reviewDecision,statusCheckRollup,body,baseRefName,number,title,author,isDraft,headRefName,isCrossRepository,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,url,mergeCommit
   gh run list -R meadow/events -c 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url
   ```

   The target, body, and head remain unchanged. The matched Actions run remains in progress, making `ci / test` binding despite `mergeStateStatus: CLEAN`. Evidence remains `source: pending`.

4. I check the worktree before rendering:

   ```sh
   git -C <scratch>/.worktrees/pr-642 rev-parse HEAD
   git -C <scratch>/.worktrees/pr-642 status --porcelain --untracked-files=no
   ```

   HEAD is the assessed pushed head, and the tracked tree is clean. I persist the retained failed prerequisite and refreshed evidence in the same run record.

5. I complete `report` and add `menu` when it starts. I select the obstacle template. Delivery remains available, but retrying an unchanged prerequisite will exit again; selecting it would first add six to each cap while preserving usage.

**Helpers dispatched:** None. No Verify, Review, or implementer helper runs on this obstacle exit. No verification command, CI watch, sync, push, or external write runs.

**Assessed SHA:** Verification evidence and the brief remain bound to `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`; the evidence is pending, not a passing verification result.

**Sync line:** None renders because the invocation contains no `--rebase`.

PR comments:
- The test check is still running, so merge waits. (ci / test)

1. The unsigned-event rejection repair remains open because it needs src/guard.ts outside the diff. (src/guard.ts)

1. deliver - resume the retained course; retry after the src/guard.ts prerequisite changes, no round charged; add 6 to each cap, preserving rounds 1/6 and syncs 0/6 as 1/12 and 0/12.
2. assess - post the open blocker to the PR, without repairs or sync.
3. stop - remove the eligible gate worktree and leave the PR unchanged. [recommended]
